selected_evidence.requirement: node3 has a single gateway address for reaching node4 (VRRP VIP 10.10.10.254) that prefers node1 while healthy
selected_evidence.summary: VRRP groups NET-A/NET-B configured on node1 (priority 200, master) and node2 (priority 100, backup); node3 route to node4's subnet uses gateway 10.10.10.254 (the VIP); baseline ping node3->node4 succeeds via node1.

selected_evidence.requirement: Gateway stays available and traffic continues when node1 (preferred router) is down
selected_evidence.summary: node1 eth1/eth2 links brought down; node2 promoted to MASTER on both VRRP groups within seconds; node3->node4 ping continued with 0% packet loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 is preferred and reclaims master once healthy again (preemption)
selected_evidence.summary: node1 links restored; node1 became MASTER again (priority 200), node2 returned to BACKUP, connectivity to node4 remained healthy.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 50503c5d...; reboot dispatched; new boot_id cdf6b9ac...; post-restart shows eth1/eth2 addresses persisted and VRRP state BACKUP as expected (node1 still master).

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state, and failover exercised live during the outage
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d...; reboot dispatched; while down, node2 was confirmed MASTER and node3->node4 ping succeeded (real failover during restart); new boot_id 2e1ef03d...; post-restart node1 reclaimed MASTER on both VRRP groups with VIPs held.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (data/config persistence)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf...; reboot dispatched; new boot_id 4abfaafd...; post-restart shows static IP 10.10.10.10/24 and route to 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.254 persisted, ping to node4 succeeds.

selected_evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (data/config persistence)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd...; reboot dispatched; new boot_id 9ce9aa41...; post-restart shows static IP 10.10.20.10/24 and route to 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.20.254 persisted, ping to node3 succeeds.

selected_evidence.requirement: Full-cluster final health check after all four restarts
selected_evidence.summary: node1 confirmed MASTER (priority 200) on NET-A and NET-B; node3->node4 ping succeeds with 0% loss, confirming end-to-end recovery and preferred-router state after the full restart sequence.
